expectations.text: Leads with stabilize-first principle (return to known-good state before root cause)
expectations.evidence: Opening: 'Principle: stabilize first, diagnose later. The bleeding stops by getting to a known-good state.'

expectations.text: Walks the five triage questions (recent apply, out-of-band changes, wide/narrow, ConfigHub healthy, paging vs post-mortem)
expectations.evidence: All five questions explicitly addressed with cub commands for each.

expectations.text: Identifies the recent ChangeSet apply as the rollback scope
expectations.evidence: Cross-references the ChangeSet via cub revision list with ChangeSet.Slug filter to confirm wide scope.

expectations.text: Hands off to rollback-revision (does not mutate directly)
expectations.evidence: Path A explicitly hands off scope + restore target + change-desc draft to rollback-revision.

expectations.text: Uses Before:ChangeSet:<slug> as the restore target (not --revision)
Includes doctrinal reminder that cub unit apply --revision is NOT a rollback
expectations.evidence: Explicit doctrinal reminder block: 'cub unit apply --revision <N> is NOT a rollback.'

expectations.text: Composes a --change-desc draft with Incident: ticket + user prompt + clarifications
expectations.evidence: Change-desc draft includes ticket reference (INC-512), user prompt verbatim, condensed clarifications.

expectations.text: Plans close-out: tag, reconciliation-check, release-verify, drift-reconcile if needed
expectations.evidence: Five-step close-out: tag the resolution, reconciliation-check, release-verify, drift-reconcile, plan root-cause.
Tool boundary: 'This skill orchestrates and decides. It does NOT mutate. Every mutation goes through the hand-off skill.'

expectations.text: Checks Worker health (mutations can't apply if Worker is down)
expectations.evidence: Question 4: cub worker status. Notes: 'If Worker is down, mutations can't apply — fix Worker first via worker-bootstrap.'
